outcome: Activating ninjutsu returns an unblocked attacker to hand and puts the ninjutsu card onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
The ninjutsu creature attacks the same player, planeswalker or battle as the returned creature.
Commander ninjutsu works as ninjutsu and also from the command zone.
note: the command zone does not occur in two-player collection, but the shared ninjutsu behavior is mechanical
